purpose: Independent per-obligation grade of one Hello World pull request (issue #1162 acceptance item 3). Each obligation is checked on its own, so a delivery fails with the names of what it missed, never with one opaque verdict. Exact stdout is only proven by an independent run; without one it is 'unobserved', never 'pass'.
newlineRule: The program writes exactly one line: the expected text followed by a single LF. No trailing spaces, no CR, no second line, no missing final newline. No trimming and no substring match.
placeholderBodyMarkers: created automatically by the AI issue solver
only the placeholder file the solver commits
